audit_metadata.title: Phase 9.1 Regression Data Audit & Model Compatibility
audit_metadata.audit_objective: Verify data consistency, sample reconciliation, feature definitions, preprocessing compatibility, and parity for Random Forest + XGBoost regression ensemble.

splits.test_status: Reused historical benchmark (NB09 baseline reuse; NOT a fresh untouched test set; tuning prohibited)

target_specification.single_sensor_formula: NEXT_AREA_CHANGE = AREA(t+1) - AREA(t) when NEXT_YEAR - AREA_YEAR == 1 else NaN

preprocessing_and_pipeline_parity.column_transformer: Numerical SimpleImputer(median) + Categorical SimpleImputer(most_frequent) & OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', sparse_output=False)
preprocessing_and_pipeline_parity.rf_xgboost_parity_assessment: PASS: Random Forest Regressor and XGBoost Regressor can be fitted on the EXACT same feature matrix, observations, target and preprocessing pipeline.
preprocessing_and_pipeline_parity.leakage_safety: All imputation and one-hot encoding must be fit strictly on training partitions; transformers must never see validation or test partitions.

frozen_baseline_contract.status: Production frozen benchmark; must NEVER be overwritten.

reconciliation_with_nb11.key_distinction: NB11 evaluated single-sensor candidate models on 20 features per sensor. It was NOT an equivalent comparison with the 36-feature fused XGBoost baseline.
reconciliation_with_nb11.empirical_finding: On S1 20-feature dataset, RF achieved MAE 0.006756 km² vs XGBoost 0.007369 km² on matched cohort (delta -0.000529 km² = -529 m²), but 95% bootstrap CI included zero [-0.001184, +0.000021] km² (not statistically significant). On S2, Persistence (zero change) beat all ML models (MAE 0.005082 km²). Fused XGBoost on 36 features remained superior (MAE 0.004792 km²).
reconciliation_with_nb11.proposed_phase9_evaluation: Train Random Forest Regressor on the identical 36-feature fused representation. Evaluate RF vs XGBoost vs optimal validation-weighted blend alpha*RF + (1-alpha)*XGBoost vs stacking with temporal expanding window.
